name: Fresh 100% Ground Chicken (Organic / Lean Butcher Cut)
whyItWorks: Finely ground fresh chicken breast and thigh meat. Extremely tender when cooked, forming fine crumbles that require minimal chewing effort and digest cleanly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook in a skillet with a dash of coconut aminos and salt. Form into gentle, non-spicy chicken patties.
